messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: data size in RATTLE
parts:
The data size essentially depends on how much memory and the
architecture. generally, on 32 bit CPUs my rule of thumb had been
about 50,000 rows and 100 columns. 32 bit is limited by the 2GB memory
limit. On 64 bit there is no 2GB limit, and we've loaded in millions
of rows. But then again it depends on what you do with the data, as
copies get made using different commands.

So in short, no built in limitation as such. But in practise, depends
on your situation and what you are doing.

Regards,
Graham
